interactions.target_raw: Type II secretion system protein J
interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb11 on EpsJ was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex of Nb11 bound to the EpsI:EpsJ heterodimer. The recombinant EpsI:EpsJ complex, in which each chain is N-terminally truncated for 24 residues was aided in the crystallization process by the addition of the nanobody. The crystals contained four similar copies of EpsI:EpsJ:Nb11 complex per unit cell.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.58 angstroms
